name: J. H. Kinzie, merchant

proprietors.name: J. H. Kinzie
proprietors.basis: The register matches the printed name to the town card kinzie_john_h (action: enrich), so this is the same person the resident layer already holds. Dated by the printing window, which bounds the reading and does not date the partnership.

locations.basis: The register matches this business onto the committed structure jh_kinzie_forwarding_store on its occupants. jh_kinzie_forwarding_store already stands and its occupants carries kinzie — 'J. H. Kinzie; forwarding and commission merchant'. The papers add trade, goods and dates to a record that exists.

dates.basis: No opening is announced. The first printing, 1835-06-20, is the bound: the house was trading by then and the record does not say when it began.

proprietor_community.basis: This record names 1 person/people the resident layer holds a card for and the layer knows no community for any of them. The silence is in the resident layer, not in the register.

replaceable_by: A directory, a deed or a later reading that names this house's premises, its staff or its dates more exactly than the newspapers do.
